name: EM FX Performance Across Fed Rate Cycles
description: Analyzes how EM currencies (BRL, MXN, ZAR) perform during Fed hiking vs cutting cycles. Inverts USD/EM pairs so positive return = EM currency appreciation. Uses 7 hardcoded Fed cycles (2001-2024) with corrected datetime_diff boundary logic. Output: cross-sectional summary table of per-cycle returns, per-asset bar chart colored by regime, and per-asset cumulative return line chart with orange/teal band shading for hike/cut periods.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM FX PERFORMANCE ACROSS FED RATE CYCLES
# =============================================================================
# Assets: USD/BRL, USD/MXN, USD/ZAR inverted (1/close) so EM appreciation = up
# 7 Fed cycles: 3 hiking, 4 cutting
# Boundary logic: datetime_diff(unit='days')(bar_ts, start) >= 0 AND
#                 datetime_diff(unit='days')(end, bar_ts) >= 0
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = 1.0 / src.c
bar_ts = index()

# Daily return of inverted series
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)

# =============================================================================
# CYCLE DATE BOUNDARIES (13 timestamp scalars)
# =============================================================================

# Cut 1: 2001-01-03 to 2003-06-25
cut1_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2001-01-03')()
cut1_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2003-06-25')()

# Hike 1: 2004-06-30 to 2006-06-29
hike1_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2004-06-30')()
hike1_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2006-06-29')()

# Cut 2: 2007-09-18 to 2008-12-16
cut2_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2007-09-18')()
cut2_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2008-12-16')()

# Hike 2: 2015-12-16 to 2018-12-19
hike2_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2015-12-16')()
hike2_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2018-12-19')()

# Cut 3: 2019-07-31 to 2020-03-15
cut3_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2019-07-31')()
cut3_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2020-03-15')()

# Hike 3: 2022-03-17 to 2023-07-26
hike3_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2022-03-17')()
hike3_e = timestamp_scalar(value='2023-07-26')()

# Cut 4: 2024-09-18 onwards (open-ended)
cut4_s = timestamp_scalar(value='2024-09-18')()

# =============================================================================
# DATETIME_DIFF BOUNDARY CHECKS
# Result = SLOT1 - SLOT0
# days_since_start = datetime_diff()(start, bar_ts) → bar_ts - start ≥ 0
# days_until_end   = datetime_diff()(bar_ts, end)   → end - bar_ts ≥ 0
# =============================================================================

# Cut 1
c1_since = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut1_s.value, bar_ts)
c1_until = datetime_diff(unit='days')(bar_ts, cut1_e.value)
in_cut1 = (c1_since.value >= 0) and (c1_until.value >= 0)

# Hike 1
h1_since = datetime_diff(unit='days')(hike1_s.value, bar_ts)
h1_until = datetime_diff(unit='days')(bar_ts, hike1_e.value)
in_hike1 = (h1_since.value >= 0) and (h1_until.value >= 0)

# Cut 2
c2_since = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut2_s.value, bar_ts)
c2_until = datetime_diff(unit='days')(bar_ts, cut2_e.value)
in_cut2 = (c2_since.value >= 0) and (c2_until.value >= 0)

# Hike 2
h2_since = datetime_diff(unit='days')(hike2_s.value, bar_ts)
h2_until = datetime_diff(unit='days')(bar_ts, hike2_e.value)
in_hike2 = (h2_since.value >= 0) and (h2_until.value >= 0)

# Cut 3
c3_since = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut3_s.value, bar_ts)
c3_until = datetime_diff(unit='days')(bar_ts, cut3_e.value)
in_cut3 = (c3_since.value >= 0) and (c3_until.value >= 0)

# Hike 3
h3_since = datetime_diff(unit='days')(hike3_s.value, bar_ts)
h3_until = datetime_diff(unit='days')(bar_ts, hike3_e.value)
in_hike3 = (h3_since.value >= 0) and (h3_until.value >= 0)

# Cut 4 (open-ended — only start check)
c4_since = datetime_diff(unit='days')(cut4_s.value, bar_ts)
in_cut4 = c4_since.value >= 0

# =============================================================================
# GATED DAILY RETURNS PER CYCLE (0 outside cycle)
# =============================================================================

safe_ret = daily_ret if is_valid(daily_ret) else 0.0

ret_cut1 = safe_ret if in_cut1 else 0.0
ret_hike1 = safe_ret if in_hike1 else 0.0
ret_cut2 = safe_ret if in_cut2 else 0.0
ret_hike2 = safe_ret if in_hike2 else 0.0
ret_cut3 = safe_ret if in_cut3 else 0.0
ret_hike3 = safe_ret if in_hike3 else 0.0
ret_cut4 = safe_ret if in_cut4 else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE RETURNS (for line chart)
# =============================================================================

cum_ret = cumulative()(safe_ret)

# Regime booleans for band shading
is_any_hike = in_hike1 or in_hike2 or in_hike3
is_any_cut = in_cut1 or in_cut2 or in_cut3 or in_cut4

# Band series: 1 during regime, 0 otherwise (is_band renders as shaded region)
hike_band = 1.0 if is_any_hike else 0.0
cut_band = 1.0 if is_any_cut else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Chart 1: Cross-Sectional Summary Table (per-cycle total returns) ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='EM FX Per-Cycle Total Return (Inverted, EM Appreciation = Positive)',
    category='Fed Cycles',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    order=0,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 1 (01-03)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hike 1 (04-06)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 2 (07-08)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hike 2 (15-18)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 3 (19-20)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hike 3 (22-23)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cut 4 (24+)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(ret_cut1, ret_hike1, ret_cut2, ret_hike2, ret_cut3, ret_hike3, ret_cut4)

# --- Chart 2: Per-Asset Bar Chart (one bar per cycle, colored by regime) ---
xy_bars(
    title='EM Currencies Rally in Cuts, Weaken in Hikes',
    category='Fed Cycles',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_label='Total Return',
    order=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cut 1 (01-03)', color=Color.Teal),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hike 1 (04-06)', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cut 2 (07-08)', color=Color.Teal),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hike 2 (15-18)', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cut 3 (19-20)', color=Color.Teal),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Hike 3 (22-23)', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Cut 4 (24+)', color=Color.Teal)
    ])
)(ret_cut1, ret_hike1, ret_cut2, ret_hike2, ret_cut3, ret_hike3, ret_cut4)

# --- Chart 3: Per-Asset Cumulative Return with Regime Band Shading ---
xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative EM FX Return with Fed Regime Shading',
    category='Fed Cycles',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    order=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hiking', color=Color.Orange, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cutting', color=Color.Teal, is_band=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Return', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=(hike_band, cut_band, cum_ret))
